considerations: Legitimate backup may read mailboxes. Compare source IP and environment history.
Correlate unexpected accesses with service principal sign-ins.
description: Find successful Graph mailbox reads by the ConnectWise applications in the published Sentinel sample.

evidence.claim: Microsoft attributed application abuse, password spraying and cloud role or credential changes to Storm-0940, a China-state-aligned actor, in activity that included the ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromise.
evidence.location: Observed attack patterns, Sentinel queries and ATT&CK mapping

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Find successful Graph mailbox reads by the ConnectWise applications in the published Sentinel sample.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Storm-0940 Cloud App Mail Access

1.json:
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AppId in ("506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae", "24205314-2b89-4e07-a2a4-579e898a5640", "0de14c77-b9b0-4137-9360-34878a929827")
| where RequestMethod == "GET" and ResponseStatusCode between (200 .. 299)
| where tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path) has_any ("messages", "mailFolders")
| extend ReportedSource = IPAddress in ("144.172.64.99", "144.172.64.60", "144.172.64.128")
| project TimeGenerated, IPAddress, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, RequestMethod, RequestUri, ResponseStatusCode, ReportedSource, ResponseSizeBytes
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
